what: Each manifesto line is covered by a background-colored veil (opacity .68) so it looks faint. From the moment the line’s top edge reaches the screen center until its bottom edge does, the veil clears from the left (clip-path inset left 0 → 100%, scrub 1) — only the line being read gets sharp, and scrolling back up covers it again

options.start · end: ScrollTrigger start and end (per line), default ”top center” · ”bottom center”
options.--fx-veil · --fx-veil-color: Curtain opacity and color (via style), default .68 · --kf-bg
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Rows (required, several) — the veil for each row is made by a part. To add your own, put [data-fx-part inside the row=veil]

use: What is it that moves me?So I move.

from.where: index.html .hk-statement — original .p-home-statement__line-mask(#fff · opacity .68) + bundle.js js-text-highlight(ge): per line a timeline scrollTrigger top center → bottom center · scrub 1 · clipPath inset(0 0 0 100%)

note: The row must be a single line with white-space: nowrap so the curtain covers only the text width (user css).
